headline: Congress approved the location in the Washington, DC area for a national memorial honoring troops who served in Operation Desert Storm and Operation Desert Shield.
what_it_does: This joint resolution approves where the National Desert Storm and Desert Shield Memorial will be built in Washington, DC and the surrounding area. The memorial itself was already authorized by an earlier defense law passed in 2014. This resolution only settles the site, which the law requires Congress to approve.
when_it_takes_effect: The resolution took effect when it was enacted on March 31, 2017.
